title: MicroservicePrd:Community

_meta.purpose: Community FD-001 source-authority lock: distinguishes the community microservice from messenger, mail, ops-dashboard/control-center, workflow-engine, social, anonymous, and retired network/shorts pointers; authorizes source-backed Plan/Spec and RED fixture cards only, not runtime implementation or production/GA claims.

authority_resolution.resolved_missing_pointer: The previous manifests-index pointer to microservices/community/manifest.json did not resolve in this checkout. The live backlog-fanout authority is this machine-readable PRD; the oya/community manifest remains tracked implementation inventory/provenance and is not sufficient for build fanout or readiness claims by itself.
legacy_or_missing_sources: /microservices/community/PRD.md (absent in this checkout; retired network successor placeholder)
/microservices/social/PRD.md (absent in this checkout; short-form video successor is /specs/microservices/social.json)
authority_resolution.claim_boundary: Source authority for planning and RED-contract decomposition only. No handler, storage, deployment, production readiness, hyperscaler maturity, GA, or customer availability claim is made by this artifact.

identity.service_boundary: A flat FD-001 community microservice covering tenant-scoped community discussions, moderation, voting/ranking, professional profile/jobs/recruiting facets absorbed from retired network, and mode-specific social/anonymous surfaces through their own machine-readable specs. Messenger and mail remain separate services; ops-dashboard/control-center and workflow-engine remain separate FD-001 surfaces.

mode_normalization.scope: tenant-scoped community forums, posts, comments/threading, votes/ranking, moderation queues, tags/roles, and community knowledge/share surfaces
mode_normalization.claim_boundary: Plan/Spec and RED fixture names must be authored before implementation handlers land.

mode_normalization.scope: visual/social mode and short-form media flavor after shorts retirement; remains inside community-mode planning rather than a product wrapper
short-form video/content format only; no standalone shorts microservice fanout from this authority lock

professional profile, connections, jobs/recruiting, endorsements, recommendations, pages/events, and professional outreach facets; LinkedIn-style engagement feed and sponsored-post promotion remain forbidden patterns

verified-anonymous workplace discussion mode; work-context only; real-identity reveal requires future threat-model, legal-hold, and four-eyes control evidence before any implementation readiness claim

plan_spec_requirements_before_build: community mode boundaries and forbidden conflations
data ownership, data classes, retention, legal hold, audit-chain, and anonymity/privacy controls
API-first REST/gRPC/event/schema contract source of truth before handlers
Workflow and Ontology mediator contracts with no direct cross-product calls
SLO, runbook, rollback, observability, capacity, backpressure, and cost envelope targets
browser/user-story and accessibility evidence requirements for any UI surface
single-writer allowed paths, conflict class, and generated-face no-hand-edit policy

acceptance_criteria.given: a worker decomposes community FD-001 work
acceptance_criteria.when: it creates Plan/Spec or RED fixture cards
acceptance_criteria.then: each card cites this artifact plus ADR-0217, manifests-index, masterplan first_deliverable, and the relevant mode spec; implementation cards remain parented behind Plan/Spec and RED gates

acceptance_criteria.given: a worker encounters oya/community inventory, registry catalog rows, task plans, proto files, or historical design-spec evidence
acceptance_criteria.then: those sources are treated as inventory/provenance only unless reconciled into this artifact or a child Plan/Spec with explicit non-claims

acceptance_criteria.given: network, shorts, social, anonymous, messenger, mail, ops-dashboard, or workflow-engine terms appear in backlog cards
acceptance_criteria.then: network and shorts are routed through the normalized community/social successors, social and anonymous cite their mode specs, and messenger/mail/ops-dashboard/workflow-engine are not treated as duplicate community coverage

downstream_lifecycle_gates.plan_spec_gate: Author community FD-001 service-boundary Plan/Spec before RED fixture names or implementation paths are assigned.
downstream_lifecycle_gates.red_fixture_gate: Create failing API/data/event/schema fixtures from the Plan/Spec before handler/storage/runtime work.
downstream_lifecycle_gates.build_gate: Build cards may only be created after Plan/Spec and RED fixture gates exist and declare single-writer allowed paths.
downstream_lifecycle_gates.review_fix_gate: Architecture, security/privacy/abuse, tenant/RBAC/policy, data/audit-chain, API/schema compatibility, observability/SLO, product UX/accessibility where UI exists, performance/backpressure, and localization/Korea pack lenses are required.
downstream_lifecycle_gates.merge_rollout_gate: Protected PR to dev, reviewer APPROVE, oya-ci-required green, rollback/observability evidence, service API/contract replay, tenant/RBAC packaging evidence, and UI user-story/browser evidence where applicable.

conflict_and_path_policy.generated_faces_policy: Never hand-edit *.generated.json; materializers own generated faces.

non_claims: No community runtime implementation is created or approved by this authority lock.

No handler, storage adapter, queue, search index, moderation engine, Workflow execution, Ontology projection, cloud deployment, live SLO, production readiness, hyperscaler maturity, or GA/customer-availability claim is made.
No implementation fanout may use oya/community dirty-tree inventory, registry catalog rows, task plans, or proto discovery as live authority without a source-backed Plan/Spec and RED fixture gate.
No retired AI-substrate/foundry backlog and no generated JSON hand edits are authorized.
